recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下正中央一顆大型雙核細胞，兩個核呈鏡像排列、各有大而嗜酸性的核仁，胞質豐富淡染，即典型 Reed-Sternberg 細胞；背景有嗜酸性球、小淋巴球、組織球與纖維化，符合 CHL 骨髓侵犯。
features: Classic binucleate Reed-Sternberg cell with mirror-image nuclear lobes and abundant pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Each lobe has vesicular chromatin and a prominent eosinophilic, inclusion-like nucleolus
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, histiocytes and plump fibroblasts
Loose fibrillary/edematous stroma replacing normal hematopoiesis in this field
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow biopsy shows a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, histiocytes and fibroblasts in a loose fibrotic stroma, without normal hematopoietic elements. A diagnostic binucleate Reed-Sternberg cell is present, with mirror-image nuclei, vesicular chromatin, large eosinophilic nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm. With CD30+, CD15+, weak PAX5+, CD20− and EBER+ large cells, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by EBV-positive classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have multilobated, hyperchromatic nuclei without large inclusion-like nucleoli and granular cytoplasm, and lack the mirror-image binucleation of an RS cell.

ddx.dx: Reed-Sternberg-like immunoblasts in infectious mononucleosis or drug reactions
ddx.vs: RS-like cells in reactive states are CD20+, CD45+ and CD15−, sit in a background of activated lymphocytes rather than fibrosis with eosinophils.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or PTCL with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: These show atypical T cells and are PAX5-negative (ALCL) or have a clonal T-cell background, requiring immunophenotyping.
